title: Streetlight out near bus stop
body: The street light has been out for a week. It's very dark and feels unsafe for kids walking home from school.

title: Overflowing trash + rats behind apartments
body: Garbage bins are overflowing and there are rats. Smell is getting worse. Please address ASAP.

title: Large pothole causing accidents
body: Pothole / crater in the right lane. Cars swerve and it's a hazard. Someone almost crashed yesterday.

title: Residents report recurring graffiti on underpass
body: Multiple residents report tagging and vandalism on the underpass walls; request cleanup and lighting improvements.

title: Mold and no heat in unit
body: Landlord hasn't fixed leak; mold spreading. No heat again this week. Elderly neighbor is struggling.
